citations.quote: The variability of excess return calculated using standard deviation is called tracking error, tracking risk, relative risk or active risk.
Each manager can restate the portfolio management problem from his perspective as active return–active risk optimization of his subportfolio.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Tracking error (relative/active risk) is the standard deviation of excess return. It splits into ex-ante (predicted by a factor model on today's positions) and ex-post (realised from a return history); the two differ in meaning and are the denominator of the Information Ratio.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Active Risk: Ex-Ante vs Ex-Post Tracking Error
